error.name: BUFFERTOOSMALL
error.description: a provided buffer is too small

error.name: COULDNOTLOADLIBRARY
error.description: the library could not be loaded

error.name: COULDNOTFINDLIBRARYEXPORT
error.description: a required exported symbol could not be found in the library

error.name: INCOMPATIBLEBINARYVERSION
error.description: the version of the binary interface does not match the bindings interface

error.name: COULDNOTGETTEMPPATHFROMWINDOWS
error.description: could not get temp path from windows

error.name: COULDNOTFINDEOSSDKDIRECTORY
error.description: could not find EOS SDK Directory

error.name: EOSSDKHASNOTBEENLOADED
error.description: EOS SDK has not been loaded

error.name: EOSSDKHASALDREADYBEENLOADED
error.description: EOS SDK has already been loaded

error.name: MACHINECONFIGTRANSFERALREADYINPROGRESS
error.description: Machine config transfer already in progress

error.name: BUILDTIMEESTIMATIONDIDNOTFINISH
error.description: Build time estimation did not finish

error.name: BUILDVOLUMEISNOTCYLINDER
error.description: Build volume is not a cylinder

error.name: EOSSDKISNOTINSIMULATIONMODE
error.description: EOS SDK is not in simulation mode.

error.name: EOSTASKFILE_NOTUNIQUE
error.description: EOS Task file is not unique.

error.name: STARTINDEXLARGERTHANENDINDEX
error.description: Start index is larger than end index.

error.name: NOPOINTSTOADDTOLAYER
error.description: No points to add to layer.

error.name: TOOLPATHCOMPUTENOTFINISHED
error.description: Toolpath computation has not finished yet.

error.name: POWERRAMPREJECTED
error.description: Toolpath contains a laser power ramp and the power ramp mode is Reject.

error.name: EXPOSURESETAMBIGUOUS
error.description: No exposure set could be chosen for a part: none or several match, and none is assigned.

error.name: UNEQUALCONSTANTHATCH
error.description: A constant modifier has different factors at the two ends of a hatch.

error.name: MODIFICATIONFACTOROUTOFRANGE
error.description: A modification factor is below 0 or above 1, and strict mode is on.

error.name: DWELLTIMEUNITMISSING
error.description: The toolpath has dwell times, but the conversion settings give no dwell time unit.

error.name: LASERINDEXUNDECLARED
error.description: A toolpath segment uses a laser index that the toolpath does not declare as laser source.

error.name: LAYERTHICKNESSINCONSISTENT
error.description: The layer Z values of a part do not follow one layer thickness.

error.name: LAYERZINVALID
error.description: A toolpath layer Z value does not fit the layer Z convention, for example a layer top at Z 0.

error.name: LAYERSTACKMISMATCH
error.description: A toolpath layer has no matching layer in the layer stack of the loaded job, and strict mode is on.

error.name: PROCESSHEIGHTEXCEEDED
error.description: The job needs more Z travel than the machine allows.

error.name: TOOLPATHORDERVIOLATION
error.description: In recording mode, a toolpath command was written in an order the EOS SDK does not accept, for example an exposure without a part.

error.name: SIMULATORNOTRECORDING
error.description: The SDK simulator does not record toolpath commands, because the simulation mode is not Recording.

error.name: FOCUSNOTSUPPORTED
error.description: A focus was requested that cannot be written: the laser scanner cannot change the focus, or the toolpath gives laserfocus as an offset in mm, which has no EOS equivalent.

error.name: INVALIDFOCUS
error.description: A focus value is outside 0.0 to 1.0, or is neither 0.0 nor 1.0 on a laser scanner that can only fully focus or defocus.

error.name: LASERSCANNERNOTAVAILABLE
error.description: A block or toolpath segment uses a laser scanner that the machine configuration does not have.

error.name: LASERSYNCNOTSUPPORTED
error.description: The toolpath asks for a synchronization between lasers with lasersync or a sync or delay segment, which an EOS task cannot express.

error.name: TOOLPATHCREDENTIALNOTFOUND
error.description: The Windows Credential Manager of the current user has no generic credential with the given name.

error.name: TOOLPATHCREDENTIALINVALID
error.description: The Windows credential cannot be read or does not hold the PEM text of a Toolpath API client key.

error.name: PROFILEPARAMETERNOTSUPPORTED
error.description: A toolpath profile has a parameter that is unknown or has no EOS equivalent, such as jumpspeed, and strict mode is on.

error.name: SHRINKAGECOMPENSATIONNOTSUPPORTED
error.description: The loaded job applies a Z shrinkage compensation, which cannot be applied to a toolpath, and strict mode is on.

method.name: ClassTypeId
method.description: Get Class Type Id

param.name: ClassTypeId
param.description: Class type as a 64 bits integer

option.name: Polyline
option.description: A hatch whose laser power, scan speed or focus ramps is written as one continuous polyline with the changed values before every sub-vector.

option.name: SplitHatches
option.description: A ramped hatch is written as separate hatches of constant values. Hatches are never joined into polylines in this mode.

option.name: Flatten
option.description: A ramped hatch is written as one hatch at its mean values.

option.name: Reject
option.description: Writing a ramped hatch or polyline vector fails with POWERRAMPREJECTED.

option.name: JoinTouching
option.description: A run of hatches in which each starts where the previous one ends, in any direction, is written as one polyline; other hatches are written as hatches.

option.name: AllPolylines
option.description: Every hatch is written as a polyline, and touching hatches are joined as in JoinTouching.

option.name: Unset
option.description: No unit. Toolpaths with dwell times are refused.

option.name: Microseconds
option.description: Dwell times are given in microseconds.

option.name: Milliseconds
option.description: Dwell times are given in milliseconds.

option.name: Seconds
option.description: Dwell times are given in seconds.

option.name: Top
option.description: The Z value of a 3MF toolpath layer is the top of the layer.

option.name: Base
option.description: The Z value of a 3MF toolpath layer is the base of the layer.

option.name: Warning
option.description: The conversion continued, but the result may differ from the input.

option.name: M808
option.description: EOS model type M808 (SDK 2.26 and later)

option.name: M450
option.description: EOS model type M450 (SDK 2.26 and later)

option.name: M451
option.description: EOS model type M451 (SDK 2.26 and later)

option.name: M405
option.description: EOS model type M405 (SDK 2.26 and later)

option.name: JobMetadata
option.description: The XML namespace of the eos3mf job metadata (machinetarget, materialname, materialthickness, paramsetname, paramsetversion) stored on the model and its parts.

option.name: MaterialSetRelationship
option.description: The relationship type of the embedded material set attachment.

option.name: ToolpathProfile
option.description: The XML namespace of the EOS toolpath profile values (eos:focus, eos:exposuretype, eos:skywriting and so on).

option.name: MachinePackage
option.description: The XML namespace of the machine configuration package index.

member.name: LaserPower
member.description: Laser power in Watts at this point. In a hatch block, the power ramps linearly from the first to the second point of a hatch. In a polyline block, it is the power of the vector that ends at this point. Values of 0 or less use the DefaultLaserPower of the block.

member.name: ScanSpeed
member.description: Scan speed in mm/s at this point, with the same rule as LaserPower. Values of 0 or less use the ScanSpeed of the block.

member.name: LaserFocus
member.description: EOS focus value at this point, from 0.0 (fully defocused) to 1.0 (fully focused), with the same rule as LaserPower. It is not a distance. Only used if HasLaserFocus is true.

member.name: HasLaserFocus
member.description: If false, the focus of the block is used. Focus values can be 0, so they need this flag.

member.name: Timestamp
member.description: EOS timestamp in microseconds that the EOS SDK reported with this point when the task was read: the time of the hatch for both points of a hatch, and of the polyline start or coordinate for a polyline point. The end point of a polyline, which has none, repeats the previous one. Ignored when writing.

member.name: LaserFocus
member.description: EOS focus value from 0.0 (fully defocused) to 1.0 (fully focused). Only used if HasLaserFocus is true.

member.name: PulsedWavePeriodTime
member.description: Pulsed Wave period time in Microseconds

member.name: PulsedWavePowerOnTime
member.description: Pulsed Wave power on time in Microseconds

member.name: PostDelay
member.description: Delay in microseconds after every hatch of a hatch block, or after the end of a polyline block. Touching collinear hatches count as one hatch.

member.name: BeamShapeProfile
member.description: Beam shape profile of the block's vectors. -1 keeps the current beam shape. Needs EOS SDK 2.26; with older SDKs, values above 0 fail in strict mode and are otherwise left out with a warning.

member.name: HasLaserFocus
member.description: If false, the block has no focus value, and its vectors are exposed with the nominal focus (1.0) unless a point sets its own focus. No focus command is written for the nominal focus, so machines without focus control accept such blocks.

member.name: StripeIndex
member.description: Number of the EOS stripe segment the block belongs to, counted from 1 within the layer when the task was read; 0 outside a stripe segment. Ignored when writing.

method.name: GetAPIVersion
method.description: Returns the EOS SDK version the simulator simulates, for example 2.18. It is the version set with SetSDKVersionOverride, otherwise the detected version.

method.name: IsRecording
method.description: Returns whether toolpath writers record their commands, that is whether the simulation mode is Recording.

param.name: Recording
param.description: True in the simulation mode Recording.

method.name: GetRecordedCommandCount
method.description: Returns the number of toolpath commands recorded since the recording started or was cleared. Every toolpath file starts with OpenFile and ends with CloseFile. Fails with SIMULATORNOTRECORDING outside the simulation mode Recording.

method.name: GetRecordedCommandName
method.description: Returns the name of a recorded toolpath command. Fails with SIMULATORNOTRECORDING outside the simulation mode Recording.

param.name: Index
param.description: Index of the command, from 0 to GetRecordedCommandCount - 1.

param.name: Name
param.description: Name of the command, for example BeginLayer, Hatch or SetLaserPower.

method.name: GetRecordedCommandArguments
method.description: Returns the arguments of a recorded toolpath command. Fails with SIMULATORNOTRECORDING outside the simulation mode Recording.

param.name: Index
param.description: Index of the command, from 0 to GetRecordedCommandCount - 1.

param.name: Arguments
param.description: Arguments of the command in the order of the corresponding EOS SDK call; coordinates in mm, Z and depth in micrometers, times in microseconds.

method.name: GetRecordedCommandsAsText
method.description: Returns all recorded toolpath commands, one per line, as the name followed by the arguments. Numbers have at most 6 decimals. Fails with SIMULATORNOTRECORDING outside the simulation mode Recording.

method.name: GetRecordedLayerCount
method.description: Returns the number of layers recorded since the recording started or was cleared. Fails with SIMULATORNOTRECORDING outside the simulation mode Recording.

method.name: ClearRecording
method.description: Removes all recorded toolpath commands. Fails with SIMULATORNOTRECORDING outside the simulation mode Recording.

method.name: SetNumberOfLaserScanners
method.description: Sets the number of laser scanners of the simulated machine. Every scanner has the field of the simulated build volume. Once it is set, in the simulation mode Recording every layer must begin a part on each of them.

param.name: Count
param.description: Number of laser scanners, from 1 to 16. Default 1.

method.name: GetNumberOfLaserScanners
method.description: Returns the number of laser scanners of the simulated machine.

method.name: GetName
method.description: Get Material Set Name

method.name: GetUUID
method.description: Get Material Set UUID

method.name: GetMaterial
method.description: Get Material Set Material

method.name: GetModelType
method.description: Returns the machine target the material set is made for, as used in OpenJob files, for example M291 for the M 290.

param.name: ModelType
param.description: Machine target. Empty if LibEOS does not know the model type of the material set.

method.name: GetBaseLayerthickness
method.description: Get Material Set Base layer thickness

param.name: Layerthickness
param.description: Material set base layer thickness in micron.

method.name: GetParameterSetVersion
method.description: Get Material Set Parameter Set Version

method.name: GetExposureSetCount
method.description: Get Exposure Set Count

method.name: GetExposureSetName
method.description: Get Exposure Set Name

method.name: GetExposureSetLayerThickness
method.description: Get Exposure layer thickness in micron

method.name: GetVolumeType
method.description: Retrieves the volume type of the machine.

method.name: GetDimensions
method.description: Retrieves dimensions of the cuboid, if VolumeType is cuboid. Fails if VolumeType is not new.

method.name: GetRadius
method.description: Retrieves dimensions of the cuboid, if VolumeType is cylindrical. Fails if VolumeType is not Cylinder.

method.name: GetModelType
method.description: Retrieves model type of the machine.

param.name: ModelType
param.description: Model type. Unknown if LibEOS does not know the model type the EOS SDK reports.

method.name: GetModelTypeIdentifier
method.description: Retrieves the machine target of the machine as used in OpenJob files, for example M304. For the M 290 this is M291. Fails with UNKNOWNMODELTYPE if the model type is Unknown.

method.name: GetModelTypeProductName
method.description: Retrieves the proper product name of the machine. (e.g. M 300-4)

method.name: GetSoftwareVersion
method.description: Retrieves the version of the software.

method.name: GetSoftwareVersionString
method.description: Retrieves the version string of the software.

method.name: GetInterfaceVersion
method.description: Retrieves the version of the machine interface.

method.name: GetInterfaceVersionString
method.description: Retrieves the version string of the machine interface.

method.name: GetSerialNumber
method.description: Retrieves the serial number of the machine.

method.name: GetNumberOfLaserScanners
method.description: Retrieves the number of laser scanners.

method.name: GetPrintDomain
method.description: Retrieves the print domain of the machine.

method.name: GetLaserScannerField
method.description: Retrieves the scan field of a laser scanner, as reported by the EOS SDK. Fails with COULDNOTGETMACHINEINFORMATION if the SDK gives no scanner details.

param.name: ScannerIndex
param.description: Index of the laser scanner, from 0 to GetNumberOfLaserScanners - 1.

param.name: MinX
param.description: Minimum X of the scan field in mm.

param.name: MinY
param.description: Minimum Y of the scan field in mm.

param.name: MaxX
param.description: Maximum X of the scan field in mm.

param.name: MaxY
param.description: Maximum Y of the scan field in mm.

method.name: GetLaserScannerLimits
method.description: Retrieves the laser power and scan speed limits of a laser scanner. Fails with COULDNOTGETMACHINEINFORMATION if the SDK gives no scanner details.

param.name: ScannerIndex
param.description: Index of the laser scanner, from 0 to GetNumberOfLaserScanners - 1.

method.name: GetLaserScannerCapabilities
method.description: Retrieves the capabilities of a laser scanner. Fails with COULDNOTGETMACHINEINFORMATION if the SDK gives no scanner details.

param.name: ScannerIndex
param.description: Index of the laser scanner, from 0 to GetNumberOfLaserScanners - 1.

param.name: FocusDefocus
param.description: The scanner can defocus the beam.

param.name: VariableFocus
param.description: The scanner can change the focus during exposure.

param.name: BeamShaping
param.description: The scanner can change the beam shape. Only reported by EOS SDK 2.26 and later.

class.name: EOSRawTaskLayer
class.description: A layer of a raw task

method.name: GetZHeight
method.description: Returns the Z Height in micrometers.

method.name: GetPointData
method.description: Returns all the points of the layer.

method.name: GetBlockData
method.description: Returns all the blocks of the layer.

method.name: ClearData
method.description: Clears all points and blocks of the layer.

method.name: AddData
method.description: Adds new blocks and points to the layer. The indices will be concatenated to match up with the current data. Fails, if indices are out of range!

class.name: EOSRawTask
class.description: A reader for a raw task

method.name: GetAbsoluteFilename
method.description: Returns the absolute filename of the task.

method.name: GetTaskDirectory
method.description: Returns the task directory.

method.name: GetNumberOfLayers
method.description: Returns the number of layers. The layers have the indices GetFirstLayerIndex to GetFirstLayerIndex + NumberOfLayers - 1.

method.name: GetFirstLayerIndex
method.description: Returns the EOS layer index of the first layer of the task. A task that starts above the build plate has a first layer index above 1.

param.name: FirstLayerIndex
param.description: EOS layer index of the first layer.

method.name: ReadLayer
method.description: Reads a layer from the EOS Task file. Fails if a read error occurs.

param.name: LayerIndex
param.description: EOS layer index to read, from GetFirstLayerIndex to GetFirstLayerIndex + GetNumberOfLayers - 1.

param.name: Layer
param.description: Instance of layer that has been read.

method.name: Release
method.description: Releases the raw task from memory.

class.name: EOSToolpathConversionSettings
class.description: Settings for converting toolpaths into EOS tasks. A conversion copies the settings when it starts, so later changes do not affect it. Setters fail with INVALIDCONVERSIONSETTINGS for invalid values.

method.name: ResetToDefaults
method.description: Sets all settings to their default values and removes all exposure set assignments.

method.name: SetStrictMode
method.description: Sets whether problems that could be corrected or left out are refused instead, for example modifier factors below 0 or above 1, unknown toolpath profile parameters, jumpspeed, or a Z shrinkage compensation of the job.

param.name: Value
param.description: True to refuse, false to correct and log a warning. Default true.

method.name: GetStrictMode
method.description: Returns whether problems that could be corrected are refused instead.

method.name: SetPowerDelay
method.description: Sets the delay passed with every laser power change.

param.name: Value
param.description: Delay in microseconds. Must not be negative. Default 190.

method.name: GetPowerDelay
method.description: Returns the delay passed with every laser power change.

method.name: SetMaxPowerStep
method.description: Sets the largest laser power difference between neighbouring sub-vectors of a ramp.

param.name: Value
param.description: Power step in Watts. Must be positive. Default 1.

method.name: GetMaxPowerStep
method.description: Returns the largest laser power difference between neighbouring sub-vectors of a ramp.

method.name: SetMaxSpeedStep
method.description: Sets the largest scan speed difference between neighbouring sub-vectors of a ramp.

param.name: Value
param.description: Speed step in mm/s. Must be positive. Default 10.

method.name: GetMaxSpeedStep
method.description: Returns the largest scan speed difference between neighbouring sub-vectors of a ramp.

method.name: SetMaxFocusStep
method.description: Sets the largest focus difference between neighbouring sub-vectors of a ramp.

param.name: Value
param.description: Step of the EOS focus value, which goes from 0.0 (fully defocused) to 1.0 (fully focused). Must be positive. Default 0.05.

method.name: GetMaxFocusStep
method.description: Returns the largest focus difference between neighbouring sub-vectors of a ramp.

param.name: Value
param.description: Step of the EOS focus value.

method.name: SetMinSubVectorLength
method.description: Sets the length of the shortest sub-vector of a ramp.

param.name: Value
param.description: Length in mm. Must be positive. Default 0.05.

method.name: GetMinSubVectorLength
method.description: Returns the length of the shortest sub-vector of a ramp.

method.name: SetPowerRampMode
method.description: Sets how ramped hatches are written.

method.name: GetPowerRampMode
method.description: Returns how ramped hatches are written.

method.name: SetHatchWriteMode
method.description: Sets how hatches are written.

method.name: GetHatchWriteMode
method.description: Returns how hatches are written.

method.name: SetJoinTolerance
method.description: Sets the largest distance between the end of a vector and the start of the next one that still counts as touching, for joining hatches and contours.

param.name: Value
param.description: Distance in mm. Must not be negative. Default 0.001.

method.name: GetJoinTolerance
method.description: Returns the largest distance between the end of a vector and the start of the next one that still counts as touching.

method.name: SetHatchPowerDeadband
method.description: Sets the smallest laser power change that is written inside joined hatches.

param.name: Value
param.description: Power in Watts. Must not be negative. Default 0.

method.name: GetHatchPowerDeadband
method.description: Returns the smallest laser power change that is written inside joined hatches.

method.name: SetJoinContours
method.description: Sets whether touching contour segments are joined into one polyline.

method.name: GetJoinContours
method.description: Returns whether touching contour segments are joined into one polyline.

method.name: SetRefuseUnequalConstantHatch
method.description: Sets whether a constant modifier with different factors at the two ends of a hatch is refused. If not, the factor at the end of the hatch is used and a warning is logged.

method.name: GetRefuseUnequalConstantHatch
method.description: Returns whether a constant modifier with different factors at the two ends of a hatch is refused.

method.name: SetDefaultSkywriting
method.description: Sets whether skywriting is enabled for profiles that do not specify it.

method.name: GetDefaultSkywriting
method.description: Returns whether skywriting is enabled for profiles that do not specify it.

method.name: SetDefaultHatchExposureType
method.description: Sets the EOS exposure type of hatches whose profile does not specify one.

method.name: GetDefaultHatchExposureType
method.description: Returns the EOS exposure type of hatches whose profile does not specify one.

method.name: SetDefaultContourExposureType
method.description: Sets the EOS exposure type of polylines and loops whose profile does not specify one.

param.name: Value
param.description: EOS exposure type, 0 to 16. Default 10 (simple contour).

method.name: GetDefaultContourExposureType
method.description: Returns the EOS exposure type of polylines and loops whose profile does not specify one.

method.name: SetLayerOpening
method.description: Sets whether every scanner starts each layer with the standard beam shape and a delay. Only written with EOS SDK 2.26 and later.

param.name: Value
param.description: True to write the layer opening. Default true.

method.name: GetLayerOpening
method.description: Returns whether every scanner starts each layer with the standard beam shape and a delay.

method.name: SetLayerOpeningDelay
method.description: Sets the delay of the layer opening.

param.name: Value
param.description: Delay in microseconds. Must not be negative. Default 10.

method.name: GetLayerOpeningDelay
method.description: Returns the delay of the layer opening.

method.name: SetDwellTimeUnit
method.description: Sets the unit of the dwell times (prewaittime and postwaittime) of the toolpath.

param.name: Value
param.description: Dwell time unit. Default Unset, which refuses toolpaths with dwell times.

method.name: GetDwellTimeUnit
method.description: Returns the unit of the dwell times of the toolpath.

method.name: SetLayerZConvention
method.description: Sets whether the Z value of a 3MF toolpath layer is the top or the base of the layer. EOS layers are given by their top, so with Base the smallest layer distance of the toolpath is added to every layer Z. With Top, a layer at Z 0 fails with LAYERZINVALID. A first layer whose Z equals the layer distance fits both conventions and is reported in the conversion log.

method.name: GetLayerZConvention
method.description: Returns whether the Z value of a 3MF toolpath layer is the top or the base of the layer.

method.name: SetAllowDefaultExposureSets
method.description: Sets whether parts whose exposure set cannot be determined may use the exposure sets _Default_DirectPart and _Default_ExternalSupport.

method.name: GetAllowDefaultExposureSets
method.description: Returns whether parts whose exposure set cannot be determined may use the default exposure sets.

method.name: SetExposureSetForThickness
method.description: Assigns the exposure set for parts or supports of a layer thickness, for thicknesses that match none or several exposure sets of the material set.

param.name: Thickness
param.description: Layer thickness in micrometers. Must be positive.

param.name: IsSupport
param.description: True for supports, false for parts.

param.name: Name
param.description: Name of the exposure set. An empty name removes the assignment.

method.name: GetExposureSetForThickness
method.description: Returns the exposure set assigned to parts or supports of a layer thickness.

param.name: IsSupport
param.description: True for supports, false for parts.

param.name: Name
param.description: Name of the exposure set. Empty if none is assigned.

method.name: ClearExposureSetsForThickness
method.description: Removes all exposure set assignments.

method.name: ToJSON
method.description: Returns all settings as a JSON object.

class.name: EOSConversionLog
class.description: The log of a toolpath conversion: messages, counters and the context of the conversion.

method.name: GetLogMessageCount
method.description: Returns the number of messages. A message that repeats within a layer is counted once.

method.name: GetLogMessage
method.description: Returns a message.

param.name: Index
param.description: Index of the message, 0 to GetLogMessageCount - 1.

param.name: Code
param.description: Stable code of the message, for example SDK_VERSION.

param.name: LayerIndex
param.description: Index of the toolpath layer the message is about, -1 if it is not about a layer. For CreateTaskFrom3MFToolpath the 0-based 3MF layer index, for a raw task writer the index passed to WriteLayer.

param.name: PartID
param.description: ID of the part the message is about, 0 if it is not about a part.

param.name: Text
param.description: Text of the message. A repeated message ends with the number of repetitions.

method.name: GetCountBySeverity
method.description: Returns the number of messages of a severity.

method.name: HasErrors
method.description: Returns whether the log contains an error.

param.name: Value
param.description: True if there is at least one error.

method.name: GetSummaryValue
method.description: Returns a counter of the conversion, for example layersWritten.

param.name: Value
param.description: Value of the counter. 0 if the counter does not exist.

method.name: GetSummaryValueCount
method.description: Returns the number of counters.

method.name: GetSummaryValueByIndex
method.description: Returns a counter by index.

param.name: Index
param.description: Index of the counter, 0 to GetSummaryValueCount - 1.

method.name: ToJSON
method.description: Returns the whole log as a JSON document.

class.name: EOSRawTaskWriter
class.description: A writer for a raw task

method.name: GetAbsoluteFilename
method.description: Returns the absolute filename of the task.

method.name: GetTaskDirectory
method.description: Returns the task directory.

method.name: WriteLayer
method.description: Writes a layer to the EOS Task file. Fails if the Z Height is not incrementing. The blocks are written per laser scanner, in ascending scanner order; the blocks of one scanner keep their order.

method.name: ConvertToTask
method.description: Closes the raw task file and begins converting it into a regular machine task. Returns a future to track conversion progress.

param.name: Name
param.description: The name of the output task.

param.name: Comment
param.description: An optional comment for the task.

param.name: GeneratorName
param.description: Name of the application that generated the task.

param.name: GeneratorVersion
param.description: Version of the application that generated the task.

param.name: Result
param.description: Task Creation Future for tracking conversion progress.

method.name: GetConversionLog
method.description: Returns the log of the layers written so far. It is the same log that the future of ConvertToTask returns.

method.name: IsRunning
method.description: Check if the background calculation is still running

param.name: Result
param.description: Flag if calculation is still running.

method.name: Abort
method.description: Abort the background calculation. Does nothing if calculation is not running.

method.description: Loads the raw task result for manual inspection. Fails if computation has not finished successfully.

method.name: LoadSDK
method.description: Forces Loading the EOSPrint SDK From Disk.

param.name: DetectedAPIVersion
param.description: Detected SDK product version, for example 2.18.1149.0. If the product version cannot be detected, the version whose structures are used, for example 2.18.

method.name: GetSDKFilePath
method.description: Returns the EOS SDK file path. MUST be called after LoadSDK.

param.name: SDKFilePath
param.description: Detected EOS SDK File Path. Empty if full SDK simulation runs without an installed SDK.

method.name: EnableSDKSimulation
method.description: Enables the simulation mode of EOS SDK Simulator. Loads the SDK from disk if it is found, but performs no calls to it. In the full SDK simulation modes an installed SDK is not required; the simulated version is the one set with SetSDKVersionOverride, otherwise the detected version, or the lowest supported version if no SDK is installed. Recording is a full SDK simulation in which raw task writers record their commands in the simulator instead of writing a file; ConvertToTask then returns a future that has finished at once and has no task file.

method.name: GetDetectedAPIVersion
method.description: Returns the detected EOS SDK version. Will load SDK if it has not been loaded yet.

param.name: DetectedAPIVersion
param.description: Detected SDK product version, for example 2.18.1149.0. If the product version cannot be detected, the version whose structures are used, for example 2.18.

method.name: SetSDKVersionOverride
method.description: Uses the structures of the given EOS SDK version instead of those of the detected version. MUST be called before the SDK is loaded. A version unknown to LibEOS uses the nearest lower known version; a version below the lowest known version fails when the SDK is loaded.

param.name: Major
param.description: Major version. 0 together with Minor 0 removes the override.

method.name: GetSDKProductVersion
method.description: Returns the product version of the loaded EOS SDK. All values are 0 if it could not be detected. Will load SDK if it has not been loaded yet.

method.name: GetSDKAdapterVersion
method.description: Returns the EOS SDK version whose structures LibEOS uses for the loaded SDK. Will load SDK if it has not been loaded yet.

method.name: GetSupportedSDKVersions
method.description: Returns the EOS SDK versions known to LibEOS.

method.name: GetSDKVersionMessages
method.description: Returns the messages of the SDK version selection, for example that an override is used or that an unknown version is handled as a lower one. Will load SDK if it has not been loaded yet.

param.name: Messages
param.description: Messages separated by line feeds. Empty if the detected version is known and not overridden.

method.description: Packs an unpacked OpenJob file, the part files it references and a material set into an OpenJZ, and loads it as job. Will load SDK if it has not been loaded yet.

param.name: OpenJobFileName
param.description: Filename of the .openjob file. Part file names in it are relative to its directory.

param.name: MaterialSetFileName

method.name: CheckLayerCoverage
method.description: Loads the job of a 3MF model with a toolpath and the machine configuration, and compares the toolpath layers with the layer stack and process heights of the EOS SDK, without writing a task. CreateTaskFrom3MFToolpath runs the same check before it writes the toolpath. Toolpath layers that are not in the layer stack are errors in strict mode and warnings otherwise; part layers without toolpath are warnings; a job that needs more Z travel than the machine allows is an error.

param.name: Model
param.description: Input 3MF Model containing geometry and a toolpath.

param.name: Settings
param.description: Conversion settings. The layer Z convention, the exposure set rules and strict mode are used.

param.name: Log
param.description: Result of the check. Errors of the check are messages of the log, not exceptions.

method.name: CheckPartToolpathAlignment
method.description: Compares, for every part of a 3MF model with a toolpath, the XY bounds of its mesh in world coordinates with the XY bounds of its toolpath vectors, and the Z range of the mesh with the Z range of its toolpath layers. Needs no SDK.

param.name: Model
param.description: Input 3MF Model containing geometry and a toolpath.

param.name: Tolerance
param.description: Largest accepted difference between the bounds in mm. Must be positive.

param.name: Log
param.description: One message per part, a warning if a bound differs by more than the tolerance.

method.name: AuthenticateToolpathAPI
method.description: Authenticates the toolpath API. Loads the SDK if it is not loaded yet. Fails if authentication is not successful. Prefer AuthenticateToolpathAPIFromCredentialStore, which keeps the client key out of the calling application.

param.name: ClientID
param.description: Client ID issued by EOS GmbH under the Toolpath API contract.

param.name: ClientKey
param.description: PEM text of the client key issued by EOS GmbH under the Toolpath API contract. The client key is a confidential credential: do not log it or store it in plain files.

method.name: AuthenticateToolpathAPIFromCredentialStore
method.description: Authenticates the toolpath API with a client key stored as a generic credential in the Windows Credential Manager of the current user. The library reads the key and erases its copies after use, so the key never passes through the calling application. Loads the SDK if it is not loaded yet. Fails with TOOLPATHCREDENTIALNOTFOUND if there is no such credential, with TOOLPATHCREDENTIALINVALID if it does not hold the PEM text of a client key, and with TOOLPATHAUTHENTICATIONFAILED if authentication is not successful.

param.name: ClientID
param.description: Client ID issued by EOS GmbH under the Toolpath API contract.

param.name: CredentialName
param.description: Target name of the generic Windows credential that holds the PEM text of the client key.

method.name: RegisterLegacyNamespace
method.description: Registers a legacy namespace that LibEOS also accepts when reading files of the given kind. Writing always uses the current namespace. Registered namespaces apply to this context and to the futures and loaders created afterwards. Note that a host reading a 3MF must still add any legacy material set relationship type to its reader with AddRelationToRead. Fails with INVALIDPARAM on an empty URI or the current namespace; a namespace already registered is ignored.

param.name: Kind
param.description: The kind of namespace the legacy URI belongs to.

param.name: NamespaceURI
param.description: The legacy namespace URI to accept when reading.

method.name: ClearLegacyNamespaces
method.description: Removes all legacy namespaces registered with RegisterLegacyNamespace.

method.description: Computes toolpath from an OpenJZ file. Internally converts the OpenJZ to a 3MF model, loads the job, activates the machine configuration, and starts async raw task generation. Toolpath API must be authenticated before calling.

param.name: OpenJZFileName
param.description: Absolute filename of the OpenJZ file to compute from.

param.name: MachineConfiguration
param.description: Machine configuration to activate for computation.

param.name: Future
param.description: Future for tracking progress and retrieving results.

method.name: CreateTaskFrom3MFToolpath
method.description: Creates an EOS task from a 3MF model containing a toolpath. Loads the job from the model's meshes, activates the machine configuration, writes the toolpath through a raw task writer and starts conversion. Laser power modifiers of the toolpath profiles are evaluated and written according to the conversion settings. Toolpath API must be authenticated before calling. Fails immediately only for invalid parameters; if the conversion fails, the returned future has failed, and its error message and conversion log give the reason.

param.name: Model
param.description: Input 3MF Model containing geometry and a toolpath.

param.name: MachineConfiguration
param.description: Machine configuration to activate for the task.

param.name: Settings
param.description: Conversion settings. They are copied, later changes do not affect the conversion.

param.name: Name
param.description: The name of the output task.

param.name: Comment
param.description: An optional comment for the task.

param.name: GeneratorName
param.description: Name of the application that generated the task.

param.name: GeneratorVersion
param.description: Version of the application that generated the task.

param.name: Result
param.description: Task Creation Future for tracking conversion progress.
